method: Inspect live Most Relevant and Most Reviewed results; deduplicate canonical course slugs against Offers and Tool track. Shortlist taught English-language SecAI+ courses rated >=4.5/5 with >=25 course ratings. These are pragmatic selection thresholds, not a claim of independently measured course quality. Rating count is Udemy course ratings, not enrolled students or instructor-wide reviews. No composite quality score invented.

selected.title: CompTIA SecAI+ (CY0-001) Complete Course from CertMike!
selected.practice: Videos and knowledge checks; no learner lab or practical exercise verified.
selected.summary: Compact instruction on AI types and training, RAG, prompting, lifecycle controls, AI attacks, access and data controls, monitoring, security automation, governance and compliance.

selected.title: CompTIA SecAI+ (CY0-001) Complete Course & Exam Prep 2026
selected.practice: 25 role plays, quizzes, assignments and one practice test advertised. Role plays involve explaining and defending decisions; completion time beyond video is not stated. Technical lab execution is not verified.
selected.summary: Extended instruction on models, prompting, RAG, threat frameworks, gateway and access controls, data protection, monitoring, attack analysis, MCP and security use cases, no-code automation, CI/CD, governance, responsible AI and regulatory frameworks.

selected.title: CompTIA SecAI+ CY0-001: Full Certification Prep Bootcamp
selected.practice: Two named ChatGPT demonstrations on threat-report summarisation and vulnerability identification, section quizzes and final practice exam. Demonstrations do not establish learner practice.
selected.summary: AI concepts, model training and prompts; secure data; threat modelling; gateway, access and data controls; monitoring and audit; attacks and compensating controls; security use cases, automation, governance and compliance.

selected.title: CompTIA SecAI+ CY0-001: The Complete AI Security Course 2026
selected.practice: Animated/interactive video lessons and two domain-weighted practice exams with explanations. Interactive presentation is not verified hands-on learner practice.
selected.summary: AI foundations, prompting and redaction, secure lifecycle, threat modelling, guardrails and gateways, IAM, monitoring, attack evidence and compensating controls, AI security use cases, low/no-code automation, change approval/rollback, agents/MCP and GRC.

selected.title: CompTIA SecAI+ CY0-001: Complete Course: AI Cybersecurity
selected.practice: 17 demonstrations advertised across the four modules, including data minimisation, model poisoning, incident summaries and authority mapping. Independent learner exercises or lab deliverables are not verified.
selected.summary: Four-module AI security course with demonstrations of prompting, data cleansing and minimisation, threat modelling, controls, attack evidence, AI-assisted categorisation/reconnaissance/reporting, governance authority and NIST risk-framework mapping.

observationLimits: Live header/search count for CertMike was 580 while its dynamically loaded review section showed 586. Use 580 consistently as the conservative header count. Alexander header was 67 (indexed web copy 66); Vision header 28 (indexed copy 27). Ratings/counts vary by refresh; recorded as dated observations. Public-site course availability does not verify inclusion in the bank's Udemy Business subscription. Avnish/Pavan and Nasser disclose AI use; the user's exclusion is specifically Mana, not a blanket exclusion of any course that uses AI.
